document_chunks.content: Viridis provides perceptually ordered colour maps intended to improve readability under common colour-vision deficiencies and grayscale printing. Choose a suitable map and check the actual figure; colour alone must not carry essential distinctions.

Brewer palettes have distinct sequential, diverging and qualitative roles. Filter the pinned palette metadata for colourblind-friendly choices and respect palette size limits. This is a selection policy, not a guarantee that every Brewer palette is accessible.

Patchwork composes plots into layouts. CTTIR uses it for figure panels, preserving panel order, aspect ratios and meaningful legend sharing. Exact composition calls and ggplot2 compatibility require pinned-version verification.

Consider Seurat and relevant extensions for suitable single-cell, spatial and multimodal tasks. Select by modality and required capability; ecosystem membership alone does not prove common authorship, compatibility or workflow approval.
Signac supports single-cell chromatin analysis and integration with other modalities. Check fragments, genome annotation, assay definition and biological replication before selecting an adapter.

Azimuth can support local reference-based annotation. CTTIR must verify query/reference compatibility, pin reference provenance and retain uncertainty or unknown labels. Selection does not authorize data upload.
BPCells is identified as an externally developed performance companion in Seurat installation guidance. Validate backed-matrix semantics, backing-file portability and memory budgets before use.

Presto is identified as an externally developed performance companion. Fast exploratory marker tests do not establish donor-level differential effects; preserve the experimental unit in scientific inference.
glmGamPoi is identified as an externally developed companion. A compatible count-model role must be justified by data and model assumptions rather than by acceleration alone.

Upstream metadata and NAMESPACE were retrieved. The export reflow_init was observed statically; its exact arguments, runtime behavior and filesystem effects remain unverified. It serves workflow infrastructure, not specialist analysis coverage.

The CRAN page reports archival on 2025-10-18. Upstream metadata remains available. Preserve the user preference only with a suitable pinned and tested source revision; explain any necessary alternative.
Bioconductor lists DEP as removed with release 3.23. Preserve historical records for pinned projects, and do not select it as a current-release default.
The ggplot2 changelog records S7 migration in version 4.0.0. Test extensions and plot assembly against the selected ggplot2 version rather than imposing an S3/S4-only rule.
